title: Minimal Sovereign Reference Node
purpose: Provide the smallest executable reference model that can pass or fail Synthsara constitutional invariants without requiring the wider mythology or worldview.
acceptanceScenario: record a contribution and increase WORTH
record and correct a memory while preserving provenance
oppose a governance proposal without losing rights
decline a Guardian recommendation without penalty
nonClaims: This prototype is not a production identity system.
This prototype is not a cryptographically immutable ledger.
Passing the suite does not prove universal ethical correctness.
WORTH is treated only as a non-transferable contribution signal in this reference model.
